notes: Cameroon (Adamawa) 5-, 15- and 22-year-old mango (Mangifera indica) stands against savannah. These are tree-crop orchards with a woody understorey, not annual crops grown under scattered trees or in alleys, so not trees_in_farmlands; closest is a tree-crop system (multistrata_shade_trees / a12 family, out_of_scope). Judgement call for a person to confirm. Even if the practice were accepted, the 'ecological service payment' values (Table 5, page 5, VE Dollar/ha: 1277.04 to 3309.69 for the stands vs 990.07 for savannah) are not carbon income: they are the carbon STOCK (Mg CO2eq/ha) multiplied by an assumed 10 USD/t CO2eq taken from Ecosystem Marketplace 2016 (page 4). No payment is made; it is a hypothetical stock valuation (modelled, secondary price). No costs, returns or adoption figures.
